The C"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"oding Agent writes ordinary React + TypeScript—not a component-tree DSL—and the interface can save u"},{"id":"p4s3","text":"ser selections for the next Agent turn."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"The result is a task-specific app that can explain a difficult relationship, collect connected choic"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"es, or continue a tool-backed workflow without asking the user to repeat their input."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"Related research: *EvoGenUI-Bench: Evaluating LLMs as Multi-Turn Generative UI Assistants*."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"Requires Node.js `^22.19.0 || ^24.0.0` and a supported DeepSeek Harness Web profile."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"v0.15.2 supports Harness `0.2.1-rc.2` (npm `latest` checked on 2026-10-23) and `0.2.1-rc.3` (`next`)"},{"id":"p10s2","text":", alongside the previously tested hosts. See the compatibility report for validation and source-inst"},{"id":"p10s3","text":"all instructions. Inline, Canvas, fullscreen, and localhost are supported. TUI/headless profiles are"},{"id":"p10s4","text":" not supported. The local compiler uses WebAssembly and needs no install-script approval. Plugin use"},{"id":"p10s5","text":"rs do not need Chrome or Chromium."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"## Where It Helps"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"Use an interface when the user needs to see a complex relationship or make several connected choices"},{"id":"p12s2","text":". Plain questions, rewriting, summaries, and simple lists should stay in prose."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"Pick calendar slots"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"Select useful writing blocks and save them to the task. A later calendar action remains separate and"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"ing blocks and save them to the task. A later calendar action remains separate and permission-gated."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"Explore photosynthesis"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"Move four causal controls and see the limiting step change immediately."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"Trace a code path"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"Turn a source-grounded CLI explanation into a local explorer of files, functions, and branches."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"## The Core Loop"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"1. The Agent writes and builds a React + TypeScript app for the current task.
2. The user saves mean"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"ingful values such as selections, form answers, drafts, or progress.
3. A later Agent turn reads tho"},{"id":"p20s3","text":"se values and continues the task.
4. Connected tools and public HTTPS routes must be declared. Harne"},{"id":"p20s4","text":"ss asks for task-scoped access, and undeclared calls are blocked."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"Later edits update the same app. A candidate that fails the build or source checks does not replace "},{"id":"p21s2","text":"the last working version; a crashing version is quarantined and rolled back when possible."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"## Inline & Canvas"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"| Inline | Canvas |"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"| A compact control or focused choice. | More room without covering the conversation. |"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"Inline, Canvas, fullscreen, and localhost are different surfaces over the same task state."},{"id":"p26s1","text":"## Try It"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"Start a new Web session and paste a prompt:"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"After saving something in the interface, ask:"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p32s1","text":"The useful proof is not only that an interface appears—it is that the next Agent turn can continue f"},{"id":"p32s2","text":"rom the interaction."},{"id":"p33s1","text":"## Why Code-First"},{"id":"p34s1","text":"Component-schema renderers are usually better for predictable cards, tables, charts, and forms. This"},{"id":"p34s2","text":" plugin is for structures that cannot be known in advance: simulations, spatial tools, source explor"},{"id":"p34s3","text":"ers, and multi-step task apps whose saved result must continue the same Harness task."},{"id":"p35s1","text":"The trade-off is deliberate: generated code is more expressive than a fixed component catalog, while"},{"id":"p35s2","text":" this project remains DeepSeek Harness-specific rather than a cross-client UI protocol. See `dsh-gen"},{"id":"p35s3","text":"ui`, `dsh-visualize`, A2UI, and MCP Apps for related approaches."},{"id":"p36s1","text":"## DESIGN.md"},{"id":"p37s1","text":"Open **Settings → Built-in plugins → Generated app design** on current hosts (or **Settings → Plugin"},{"id":"p37s2","text":"s → Plugin configuration** on older hosts) to choose automatic design selection, use `material-3`, `"},{"id":"p37s3","text":"apple-human-interface`, or `shadcn-ui`, or import a custom `DESIGN.md`. The file controls visual lan"},{"id":"p37s4","text":"guage, not page structure; React remains free to implement the interaction the task needs."},{"id":"p38s1","text":"## Safety"},{"id":"p39s1","text":"Generated code runs in an opaque-origin sandbox. A trusted parent keeps the real task capability tok"},{"id":"p39s2","text":"en and brokers only saved state, declared tools, and declared credential-free public HTTPS routes. M"},{"id":"p39s3","text":"CP credentials never enter generated code. Temporary links and grants expire after 7 days, as does t"},{"id":"p39s4","text":"ask state 7 days after its last update."},{"id":"p40s1","text":"This boundary protects host credentials and capabilities, but it cannot make malicious code safe to "},{"id":"p40s2","text":"trust with data already authorized for it to read. Do not put secrets in generated-app state or gran"},{"id":"p40s3","text":"t access to data the app should not display.
